title: HarfBuzz avar2 breakpoint processing can amplify subset CPU work
ai_system: Anthropic OSS Scanner (model not identified for this discovery)
summary: avar2 subsetting processes breakpoints quadratically during offset compensation. The maintainer reports a 131 KB font taking 42 seconds of CPU, with work repeated on serializer retries.
ai_role: The primary maintainer commit explicitly says “Discovered by Anthropic's OSS Scanner, as vulnerability ANT-2026-CWJXX1BL.” It separately lists Claude Opus 4.8 as a commit co-author; the source does not establish that model as the discovering system or describe its investigative steps.
classification_note: The maintainer source explicitly calls this a vulnerability and describes resource exhaustion from crafted font inputs in the subset path. It does not report exploitation in the wild.
remediation_note: The maintainer commit first added a budget around quadratic work, then revised the final correction to use binary search for map lookups, removing the quadratic CPU cost. The commit does not establish an affected or fixed release boundary.

impacts.conditions: A crafted font supplied to the avar2 subsetting path can cause disproportionate CPU work; the maintainer reports 42 seconds for a 131 KB input.
impacts.exploitation: The cited maintainer source reports resource consumption from crafted test inputs; it does not report exploitation in the wild.
